inputs.text: This is the playbook in plain sight: the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice used “religious freedom” to challenge a prolife law, and an Indiana judge blocked it. The legal language may sound neutral, but the real contest is over who gets to define the principle—and institutions are turning it into a tool for weakening abortion limits. LifeNews’s framing shows the fight over the story is part of the fight itself.
